reference_audio.note: With reference_text the clone is in-context (acoustic continuation + speaker embedding); without it the engine falls back to speaker-embedding-only cloning.  The engine caches encoded prompts per clip, so repeated requests for the same clip are cheaper.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Text to synthesize, e.g. 'Hello there'.  Inline paralinguistic tags are supported (Chinese or English): [Breathing], [Cough], [Sigh], [Laughter], [Surprise-ah], [Surprise-oh], [Dissatisfaction-hnn], [Uhm], [Confirmation-en], [Question-ei], [Question-ah], [Question-en], [Question-oh], [Question-huh].

parameters.name: audio_base64
parameters.description: Reference voice sample as a base64 string.  Any container soundfile can decode (WAV, MP3, OGG, FLAC, ...); any input sample rate (the engine resamples).  ~3-10 s of clean speech is the sweet spot.

parameters.name: reference_text
parameters.description: Exact transcript of the reference audio.  With it, cloning is in-context (the reference clip's acoustic continuation plus its speaker embedding) and matches the reference closely.  Omitted, the engine falls back to speaker-embedding-only cloning (timbre closer, prosody freer).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Two-letter language code (supported: de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, zh).  Omitted or empty defaults to 'en'.  Set it to the language of *text*.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Random seed for reproducibility.  If omitted, a random seed in [1, 1000] is chosen and echoed in the response.  Note: the engine caches encoded reference prompts in memory per clip: repeat requests with the same seed reproduce each other, but the first request for a clip draws RNG the later ones skip, so it is only reproducible after a server restart (wiping the staging dir does not reset the cache).

parameters.name: cfg
parameters.description: Flow-matching classifier-free guidance scale.  Engine default 2.0.  Must be finite and > 0.

parameters.name: sigma
parameters.description: Flow-matching noise scale.  Engine default 0.25.  Must be finite and >= 0.

parameters.name: temperature
parameters.description: Sampling temperature.  Engine default 0.0 (greedy); raise for more variation.  Must be finite and >= 0.
